chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube Shorts / TikTok cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Keep the focal point and the text inside the centre safe area: clear of the bottom 25% and of the right-hand button column.
Subject: two equal clouds of tiny dots side by side: the left cloud tiny white stars, the right cloud small lemon-green tree shapes (an illustration).
Composition: the two clouds stacked left and right of centre with a thin dark gap between, centred in the upper two thirds; empty indigo night around them.
Lighting and treatment: white stars (#EEF0FF) against lemon-green trees (#C8E65A) on indigo night (#0B0F2A), soft bloom, subtle grain.
Mood: curiosity.
Text: "Guess first." in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), centred in the lower middle, white.
Scientific accuracy: estimates: the Milky Way holds about 100 to 400 billion stars; Earth is estimated to hold about 3 trillion trees, so trees probably win by roughly 8 to 30 times; both are estimates.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news or NASA photo. It must read as a code-rendered illustration in the channel's look (indigo night #0B0F2A, teal #4FE3C6 light fronts, violet #5B3FD0).
Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
